title: Icon-only task manager: App being pinned in another activity affects its position in taskbar
line: An app pinned only on another activity no longer jumps to the front of the Task Manager when you open it.
explanation: The Task Manager sorts windows into the slot of their app's pinned launcher, but it looked the launcher up in the full launcher list, ignoring which activities it is pinned on. So the window of an app pinned only on another activity was treated as a pinned task and sorted before all other windows: in the Icons-only Task Manager through the launch-in-place sort, in the Task Manager (launchers not kept separate) through the sort map, which also took a launcher hidden by the activity filter for one hidden by its running window. The change adds a helper that ignores launchers not on the current activity and uses it in the sort, the drag barrier and the sort map, and re-sorts the tasks when the current activity changes, so a window shown on several activities takes its launcher slot only where that launcher is pinned.

commits.message:
libtaskmanager: ignore launchers on other activities when sorting

Windows were sorted into the slot of a launcher pinned only on another
activity, so they jumped to the front. Now only launchers on the current
activity count when sorting, and tasks are re-sorted when it changes.

BUG: 386055

media.caption: Master, Icons-only, Default activity, Dolphin and Konsole open. Rows 1-2: Info Center pinned only on Activity 2; rows 3-4: launching it on Default puts its window first.
Fixed, Icons-only on Default: Info Center pinned only on Activity 2, Konsole pinned on all activities. Dolphin then Info Center opened: Info Center goes to the end.
Previous version of this fix (reviewed): same windows put on all activities, then switched to Activity 2, where Info Center is pinned first. Its window stays last instead of taking its slot.
Fixed, same steps: on Activity 2 the Info Center window moves into its pinned slot, before Konsole and Dolphin.
Task Manager with launchers not kept separate (code path same as master): Info Center pinned only on Activity 2, opened on Default after Dolphin, jumps to the front.
Fixed, same steps in the Task Manager: Info Center goes after Dolphin.
Fixed, Icons-only: switching Activity 2 -> Default -> Activity 2 with the windows on all activities. Info Center takes its slot on Activity 2 and leaves it on Default.
